description: GNSS - Danmark is the Dataforsyningen data product with observation files from Denmark's permanent GNSS reference stations, run by the Danish Agency for Climate Data. The product page read on 2026-09-28 says the Danish geographic reference rests on 14 GNSS stations that tie the national reference network to European and global frames, that the product also includes 11 stations of the TAPAS testbed for precision positioning and autonomous systems around Aarhus plus twin and class-B backup stations, and that data are offered by FTP as RINEX 2 (until 31 December 2021) and RINEX 3 at 1-second and 30-second sampling with navigation files, Hatanaka-compressed in daily files, together with IGS site logs. Coverage is Denmark. Access is free with a Dataforsyningen login; the terms were not read. Caveats: the files serve post-processing, not real-time corrections, which come from other services. It supports GNSS reference data for positioning infrastructure resilience studies, such as ionospheric disturbance effects during geomagnetic storms. Related records: data-gnet-greenland-gnss-rinex-data and data-nsgi-netherlands-gnss-reference-data are comparable networks.
